blocks.content:
Transformations are a powerful way to manipulate data returned by a query before the system applies a visualization. Using transformations, you can:

- Rename fields
- Join time series/SQL-like data
- Perform mathematical operations across queries
- Use the output of one transformation as the input to another transformation

In this interactive guide, you'll set up a basic dashboard using the preinstalled Grafana data source and briefly explore the Transformations tab.
Open a new dashboard for this exercise.
If onboarding appears, click **Skip to dashboard**.
Create a panel with two sample series from the built-in Grafana data source.
Click **Add** to open the dashboard element sidebar.
Click **Panel** to add a panel to the dashboard.

blocks.reftarget: button[data-testid='data-testid sidebar configure panel button'], button[data-testid='data-testid edit pane configure panel button']
blocks.content: Click **Edit visualization** to open the panel editor.
Select **-- Grafana --** in the **Data source** picker.
Select **Line chart** to visualize the sample series.
In the **Queries** tab below the panel, change the **Series count** to 2 to add another series to the visualization.
Click **Refresh**.
You created a line chart with two sample series.
Add a calculation, filter a field, and explore transformation help and removal.
Use the **New query editor** experience to add and manage transformations.

blocks.reftarget: div[data-testid='data-testid Panel editor content'] button[aria-label='Add transformation']
blocks.content: Click **Add transformation** in the **Data** sidebar.
Choose a transformation to change the query results before displaying them.
Select **Add field from calculation**.
The default **Total** calculation adds a series by summing the existing series values.
Next, filter a field and explore the transformation controls.
Add the **Filter fields by name** transformation.

steps.reftarget: div[data-testid='data-testid Panel editor content'] button[aria-label='Add transformation']

blocks.reftarget: div[data-testid='data-testid Transformation editor Filter fields by name'] button:text('A-series')
blocks.content: Click the **A-series** pill to filter out that field.
Open the filter transformation help, then click **Close** when you finish reading.

blocks.content: Remove **Filter fields by name**, then confirm the deletion.

section[data-stacked-editor-item-type='transformation']:has([data-testid='data-testid Transformation editor Filter fields by name']) [role='group'][aria-label='Delete confirmation'] button[aria-label='Confirm']

blocks.content: Confirm that **Add field from calculation** remains and **Filter fields by name** has been removed.
You added a calculation, filtered a field, viewed help, and removed the filter while keeping the calculation.
